```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

### Path to saving to server
```{r}
file_path = "/srv/shiny-server/snip/processed_data/"
```

### Load datasets
```{r}
weekly_screening <- read_csv(here("raw_data/weekly_screening.csv"))
entry_df <- read_csv(here("raw_data/entry_df.csv"))
progress_chart_df <- read_csv(here("raw_data/progress_chart_df.csv"))
exit_df <- read_csv(here("raw_data/exit_df.csv"))
lab_results_df <- read_csv(here("raw_data/lab_results_df.csv"))
```
### Processing weekly screening data
```{r}
load(here("raw_data", "meta_screening.RDS"))
meta_screening <- get("meta_screening")
weekly_screening <- rename_checkboxes(weekly_screening, meta_screening)
# Add week number to dataset
study_start_date <- as.Date("2025-09-01")

weekly_screening <- weekly_screening %>%
  mutate(
    week = as.integer(floor(as.numeric(s_date_scr - study_start_date) / 7)) + 1) 

weekly_screening <- weekly_screening %>% 
  select(record_id, week,everything())

save(weekly_screening,file = paste0(file_path, "weekly_screening.RData") )
write_csv(weekly_screening, file = here("raw_data","weekly_screening.csv")) 
```
## Processing entry data
```{r}
### Generate new variables ( Year_Monthj, length of stay)
entry_df <- entry_df %>% 
  mutate(
    Year_Month = format(date_enrol_adm, "%Y-%m"),
    Week = as.integer(floor(difftime(date_enrol_adm, study_start_date, units = "days") / 7) + 1))

## Rename variables  
entry_df <- entry_df %>%
  rename(site = redcap_data_access_group,
    clin_sign_temp = clinical_sign_adm___1,
    clin_sign_chest_indrawing = clinical_sign_adm___2,
    clin_sign_abdominal_distention = clinical_sign_adm___3,
    clin_sign_difficulty_feeding = clinical_sign_adm___4,
    clin_sign_shock = clinical_sign_adm___5,
    clin_sign_lethargy = clinical_sign_adm___6,
    clin_sign_cyanosis = clinical_sign_adm___7,
    clin_sign_heart_rate = clinical_sign_adm___8,
    clin_sign_convulsion = clinical_sign_adm___9,
    clin_sign_irritability = clinical_sign_adm___10)

save(entry_df,file = paste0(file_path, "entry_df.RData"))
write_csv(entry_df, file = here("raw_data","entry_df.csv"))

```

### Weekly screening value boxes
```{r}
Screened <- sum(weekly_screening$t_screen_scr, na.rm = TRUE)
Eligible <- sum(weekly_screening$t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE)
Eligible <- paste0(Eligible, " (", round(Eligible / Screened * 100, 1), "%)")
Not_Eligible <- sum(weekly_screening$t_not_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE)
Not_Eligible <- paste0(Not_Eligible, " (", round(Not_Eligible / Screened * 100, 1), "%)")
Enrolled <- sum(weekly_screening$t_eligible_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE)
Enrolled <- paste0(Enrolled, " (", round(Enrolled / sum(weekly_screening$t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)")
Not_Enrolled <- sum(weekly_screening$t_eligible_not_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE)
Not_Enrolled <- paste0(Not_Enrolled, " (", round(Not_Enrolled / sum(weekly_screening$t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1), "%)")

screening_value_boxes <- data.frame(Screened= Screened, Eligible = Eligible, Not_Eligible = Not_Eligible, Enrolled = Enrolled, Not_Enrolled = Not_Enrolled)

save(screening_value_boxes,file = paste0(file_path, "screening_value_boxes.RData") )

```
### Weekly screening summary 
```{r}
### Weekly screening by site 
weekly_screening_by_site <- weekly_screening %>%
  group_by(Site = redcap_data_access_group,Week = week, Week_Start_Date = s_date_scr, Week_End_Date  = e_date_scr) %>%
  summarise(
    Screened = sum(t_screen_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Eligible = sum(t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Not_Eligible = sum(t_not_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE), 
    Enrolled = sum(t_eligible_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Not_Enrolled = sum(t_eligible_not_enrol_scr,na.rm = TRUE ),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Week))

save(weekly_screening_by_site,file = paste0(file_path, "weekly_screening_by_site.RData"))

### Cumulative screening 
weekly_screening_summary <- weekly_screening %>%
  group_by(Site = redcap_data_access_group) %>%
  summarise(
    Screened = sum(t_screen_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Eligible = sum(t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    Enrolled = sum(t_eligible_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  bind_rows(
    summarise(., 
              Site = "All Sites",
              Screened = sum(Screened),
              Eligible = sum(Eligible),
              Enrolled = sum(Enrolled))
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Eligible (%)` = paste0(Eligible, " (", round(100 * Eligible / Screened, 1), "%)"),
    `Enrolled (%)` = paste0(Enrolled, " (", round(100 * Enrolled / Eligible, 1), "%)"),
    Screened = as.character(Screened)
  ) %>%
  select(Site, Screened, `Eligible (%)`, `Enrolled (%)`) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Site, names_to = "variable", values_to = "value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Site, values_from = value)

save(weekly_screening_summary,file = paste0(file_path, "weekly_screening_summary.RData"))
```
### Reasons for Not Eligible 
```{r}
reasons_not_elig_df <- weekly_screening %>% 
  select(site_scr,age_greater_29days_scr, sepsis_criteria_not_met_scr,other_not_eligible_scr, other1_not_elig_spec_scr,other2_not_elig_spec_scr)

reasons_not_eligible_summary <- reasons_not_elig_df %>% 
  select(
    Site = site_scr,
    `Age>29 days` = age_greater_29days_scr,
    `Did not meet sepsis criteria` = sepsis_criteria_not_met_scr,
    `Other` = other_not_eligible_scr
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Site,
    names_to = "Reason",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Reason, Site) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Site,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  # Add All column summing across site columns
  mutate(All_Sites = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  adorn_totals(where = "row")  # optional total row
 

kbl(reasons_not_eligible_summary, valign = "t", booktabs = T,linesep = "\\addlinespace") %>%
kable_styling(latex_options = "striped",full_width = T,font_size = 14)


save(reasons_not_eligible_summary,file = paste0(file_path, "reasons_not_eligible_summary.RData") )
```

### Other reasons Not Eligible 
```{r}
other_reasons_not_eligible <- reasons_not_elig_df %>%
  select(site_scr, other1_not_elig_spec_scr, other2_not_elig_spec_scr) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("other"),
    names_to = "other_reason_type",
    values_to = "other_reasons_not_eligible"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(other_reasons_not_eligible) & other_reasons_not_eligible != "") %>%
  group_by(Site = site_scr, other_reasons_not_eligible) %>%
  summarise(Total = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(Site, desc(Total))

save(other_reasons_not_eligible,file = paste0(file_path, "other_reasons_not_eligible.RData") )
```
### Reasons for Not enrolled 
```{r}
reasons_df <- weekly_screening %>% 
  select(site_scr,refuse_miss_consent_scr, died_scr, lama_scr, absconded_scr,other1_not_enrol_spec_scr,other2_not_enrol_spec_scr)
reasons_not_enrolled_summary <- reasons_df %>%
  select(
    Site = site_scr,
    `Refused or Missed Consent` = refuse_miss_consent_scr,
    Died = died_scr,
    LAMA = lama_scr,
    Absconded = absconded_scr
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Site,
    names_to = "Reason",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Reason, Site) %>%
  summarise(Count = sum(Count, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Site,
    values_from = Count,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  # Add 'All Sites' column summing across all site columns
  mutate(All_Sites = rowSums(across(where(is.numeric)))) %>%
  adorn_totals(where = "row")

save(reasons_not_enrolled_summary,file = paste0(file_path, "reasons_not_enrolled_summary.RData") )
```

### Neonatal rooms selected 
```{r}
neo_rooms <- weekly_screening %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("neo_rm"),
    names_to = "room_code",
    values_to = "checked"
  ) %>%
  filter(checked == "Checked") %>%
  mutate(
    # Remove 'neo_rm_' and the site code
    room_label = sub("^neo_rm_[^_]+_", "", room_code),
    # Replace underscores with spaces
    room_label = gsub("_", " ", room_label)
  ) %>%
  group_by(Site = site_scr) %>%
  summarise(
    Neo_Rooms_Included = paste(unique(room_label), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

save(neo_rooms,file = paste0(file_path, "neo_rooms.RData") )

```
### Weekly screening queries 
```{r}
### Not eligible and not eligibel reasosn mismatch
not_eligible_queries <- weekly_screening %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    reasons_not_eligible_sum = sum(c_across(
      c(age_greater_29days_scr,
        sepsis_criteria_not_met_scr,
        other_not_eligible_scr)
    ), na.rm = TRUE),
    
    query_flag = t_not_eligible_scr != reasons_not_eligible_sum,
    
    query_note = ifelse(
      query_flag,
      paste0("Mismatch: t_not_eligible_scr (", t_not_eligible_scr,
             ") ≠ sum of reasons (", reasons_not_eligible_sum, ")"),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(query_flag) %>%
  select(
    record_id,week,site_scr,
    t_not_eligible_scr,
    reasons_not_eligible_sum,
    query_note
  )

save(not_eligible_queries,file = paste0(file_path, "not_eligible_queries.RData") )
```
### Not enrolled and not enrolled reason mismatch 
```{r}
not_enrolled_reason_cols <- c(
  "refuse_miss_consent_scr",
  "died_scr",
  "lama_scr",
  "absconded_scr",
  "other_not_enrol_scr"
)
# Check mismatches
not_enrolled_queries <- weekly_screening %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    reasons_sum = sum(c_across(all_of(not_enrolled_reason_cols)), na.rm = TRUE),
    mismatch_flag = t_eligible_not_enrol_scr != reasons_sum,
    query_note = ifelse(
      mismatch_flag,
      paste0(
        "Mismatch: Not Enrolled (", t_eligible_not_enrol_scr,
        ") ≠ Sum of reasons (", reasons_sum, ")"
      ),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(mismatch_flag) %>%
  select(record_id,week, site_scr, t_eligible_not_enrol_scr, reasons_sum, query_note)

save(not_enrolled_queries,file = paste0(file_path, "not_enrolled_queries.RData") )
```
### Weekly screening plots 
```{r}
weekly_screening_plot <- weekly_screening %>%
  group_by(Site = redcap_data_access_group) %>%
  summarise(
    `Total screened` = sum(t_screen_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Total eligible` = sum(t_eligible_scr, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Total enrolled` = sum(t_eligible_enrol_scr, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  mutate(Site = factor(Site, levels = Site[order(-`Total screened`)])) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = `Total screened`:`Total enrolled`, names_to = "Status", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(Status = factor(Status, levels = c("Total screened", "Total eligible", "Total enrolled")))

ggplot(weekly_screening_plot, aes(x = Site, y = Count, fill = Status)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = Count),
    position = position_dodge(0.9),
    vjust = -0.3,
    size = 3
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly Screening Summary per Site",
    x = "Site",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Status"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```
### Generate Enrolment reports 
### Entry: KPI value boxes 
```{r}
admitted_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(!is.na(entry_df$date_adm))))
enrolled_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(!is.na(entry_df$date_enrol_adm))))
currently_in_ward_kpi <- as.numeric(
  entry_df %>%
    filter(!record_id %in% exit_df$record_id) %>%  # not yet exited
    distinct(record_id) %>%
    nrow()
)
currently_in_ward_kpi = paste0(currently_in_ward_kpi, " (", round(currently_in_ward_kpi/admitted_kpi*100,1), "%)")
discharged_alive_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Discharged")))
discharged_alive_kpi = paste0(discharged_alive_kpi, " (", round(discharged_alive_kpi/enrolled_kpi*100,1), "%)")
deaths_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Died")))
deaths_kpi = paste0(deaths_kpi, " (", round(deaths_kpi/enrolled_kpi*100,1), "%)")
lama_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Left against medical advice")))
transferred_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Transferred")))
absconded_kpi <- as.numeric(length(which(exit_df$outcome_sc == "Absconded")))

kpi_value_boxes <- data.frame(admitted_kpi = admitted_kpi,enrolled_kpi = enrolled_kpi, currently_in_ward_kpi = currently_in_ward_kpi,discharged_alive_kpi = discharged_alive_kpi,deaths_kpi = deaths_kpi, lama_kpi = lama_kpi,transferred_kpi =transferred_kpi,absconded_kpi  )

save(kpi_value_boxes,file = paste0(file_path, "kpi_value_boxes.RData"))
```

### Enrolment by site 
```{r}
enrolment_curve_site <- entry_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(date_enrol_adm)) %>%
  mutate(date_enrol_adm = as.Date(date_enrol_adm)) %>%
  group_by(site, date_enrol_adm) %>%
  summarise(daily_enrol = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  arrange(date_enrol_adm) %>%
  mutate(cum_enrol = cumsum(daily_enrol))

# Get the last point for each site
last_points <- enrolment_curve_site %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  filter(date_enrol_adm == max(date_enrol_adm))

# Plot cumulative enrolment by site
ggplot(enrolment_curve_site, aes(x = date_enrol_adm, y = cum_enrol, color = site)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_text(
    data = last_points,
    aes(label = cum_enrol),
    vjust = -0.5, size = 4, show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Enrolment Curve by Site",
    x = "Date of Enrolment",
    y = "Cumulative Number Enrolled",
    color = "site"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```

#### Enrolments previous weeks , current week
```{r}
# get the latest week
current_week <- max(entry_df$Week, na.rm = TRUE)

# summarise entry enrolments by period
entry_enrol_summary <- entry_df %>%
  mutate(period = case_when(
    Week < current_week ~ "Previous weeks",
    Week == current_week ~ "Current week"
  )) %>%
  group_by(site, period) %>%
  summarise(
    enrolled_from_entry = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = period,
    values_from = enrolled_from_entry,
    values_fill = 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Previous_weeks = `Previous weeks`,
    Current_week   = `Current week`,
    Cumulative     = `Previous weeks` + `Current week`
  ) %>%
  select(site, Previous_weeks, Current_week, Cumulative) %>%
  arrange(site)

# add the "All sites" total as the last row
entry_enrol_summary <- bind_rows(
  entry_enrol_summary,
  summarise(entry_enrol_summary,
    site = "All sites",
    Previous_weeks = sum(Previous_weeks, na.rm = TRUE),
    Current_week   = sum(Current_week, na.rm = TRUE),
    Cumulative     = sum(Cumulative, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)
save(entry_enrol_summary,file = paste0(file_path, "entry_enrol_summary.RData"))
```

### Patient Progress Reports 

### No. of children who recieved supoort care 
```{r}
ppc_support <- progress_chart_df %>%
  group_by(site, record_id) %>%
  summarise(
    Oxygen = any(oxygen_day_ppc == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    NIV = any(niv_day_ppc == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    CVC = any(cvc_day_ppc == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    PVC = any(pvc_day_ppc == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    IVFluids = any(inv_day_ppc == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    HumanMilk = any(human_milk_day_ppc == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    Probiotic = any(probiotic_day_ppc == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    KangarooCare = any(kangaroo_care_day_ppc == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    Enrolled = n_distinct(record_id),
    across(Oxygen:KangarooCare, ~ sum(.x, na.rm = TRUE)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(Oxygen:KangarooCare,
                ~ paste0(.x, " (", round(.x / Enrolled * 100, 1), "%)")))

save(ppc_support, file = paste0(file_path, "ppc_support.RData"))

```
### Support care Total days 
```{r}
# Mapping for readable names
support_labels <- c(
  oxygen_day_ppc = "Oxygen",
  niv_day_ppc = "NIV",
  cvc_day_ppc = "CVC",
  pvc_day_ppc = "PVC",
  inv_day_ppc = "IV Fluids",
  human_milk_day_ppc = "Human Milk",
  probiotic_day_ppc = "Probiotic",
  kangaroo_care_day_ppc = "Kangaroo Care"
)

total_days_ppc <- progress_chart_df %>%
  summarise(across(c(oxygen_day_ppc:niv_day_ppc, cvc_day_ppc:pvc_day_ppc,
                     inv_day_ppc, human_milk_day_ppc:kangaroo_care_day_ppc),
                   ~ sum(.x == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE), .names = "{.col}_Count")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "supportive_care", values_to = "Count") %>%
  mutate(
    supportive_care = gsub("_Count", "", supportive_care),
    supportive_care = recode(supportive_care, !!!support_labels)
  ) %>%
  select(supportive_care, Count) %>% 
    arrange(desc(Count))

save(total_days_ppc, file = paste0(file_path, "total_days_ppc.RData"))

```

### Outcome Value boxes 
```{r}
outcome_boxes <- entry_df %>%
  select(record_id) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  left_join(exit_df %>% select(record_id, site,outcome_sc), by = "record_id")

Enrolled <- as.numeric(length(which(!is.na(outcome_boxes$record_id))))
Discharged <-  as.numeric(sum(outcome_boxes$outcome_sc == "Discharged",na.rm = TRUE))
Died <- as.numeric(sum(outcome_boxes$outcome_sc == "Died", na.rm = TRUE))
Absconded <- as.numeric(sum(outcome_boxes$outcome_sc == "Absconded", na.rm = TRUE))
Left_against_medical_advice <- as.numeric(sum(outcome_boxes$outcome_sc == "Left against medical advice", na.rm = TRUE))
Transferred <- as.numeric(sum(outcome_boxes$outcome_sc == "Transferred",na.rm = TRUE))
Still_admitted = as.numeric(sum(is.na(outcome_boxes$outcome_sc)), na.rm = TRUE)

outcome_value_boxes <- data.frame(Enrolled = Enrolled, Discharged= Discharged, Died = Died, Left_against_medical_advice = Left_against_medical_advice,Absconded = Absconded,Transferred = Transferred, Still_admitted = Still_admitted )
```

### Outcome per site 
```{r}
outcome_summary <- entry_df %>%
  left_join(exit_df %>% select(record_id, outcome_sc), by = "record_id") %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    Enrolled = sum(!is.na(date_enrol_adm)),
    Discharged = sum(outcome_sc == "Discharged", na.rm = TRUE),
    Died = sum(outcome_sc == "Died", na.rm = TRUE),
    LAMA = sum(outcome_sc == "Left against medical advice", na.rm = TRUE),
    Transferred = sum(outcome_sc == "Transferred", na.rm = TRUE),
    Absconded = sum(outcome_sc == "Absconded", na.rm = TRUE),
    Not_discharged = as.numeric(sum(is.na(outcome_sc)), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() 

save(outcome_summary,file = paste0(file_path, "outcome_summary.RData"))
```
